physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfResolution.meaning_guard: Grid spacing is the maximum mesh AABB extent divided by 256; this is not a vertex budget.

physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfBitsPerSubgridP.meaning_guard: Distance precision used for sparse SDF subgrids at the registered subgrid resolution.

physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfNarrowBandThick.meaning_guard: Dimensionless fraction of the mesh bounding-box diagonal, not 0.01 meters.

physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfMargin.meaning_guard: The SDF domain boundary is enlarged in each direction by 1 percent of the mesh bounding-box diagonal; this is not a claim that the zero-isosurface or collision surface itself is inflated by 1 percent.

cooking_wait.source: process-wide counter formula adapted from the installed NVIDIA PhysxTriangleMeshCollisionAPI test; unlike that test, D400 deliberately does not release the process-global local mesh cache
cooking_wait.interface_classification: private, version-pinned, process-wide cooking diagnostics; not a public per-prim SDF identity API
cooking_wait.baseline: capture scheduled, finished, cache-hit, and cache-miss counters before attach; baseline running_tasks must equal 0
cooking_wait.success: after attach, scheduled_delta must be greater than 0, finished_delta must equal scheduled_delta, and final running_tasks must equal 0 within both watchdogs
cooking_wait.cache_policy: Do not clear process-global caches because cache mutation is outside this case. Record hit/miss deltas. This intentionally differs from the installed NVIDIA test setup, which releases the local mesh cache. If scheduled_delta is 0, fail as inconclusive rather than claiming an SDF cook.
cooking_wait.kit_update_pumps: bounded and counted; each pump is not a physics step; raw timeline remains STOP at time 0
cooking_wait.authority_limit: Passing this drain gate proves only that stage-wide scheduled cooking work occurred and drained. It does not identify an internal SDF object, cooked zero-isosurface, or collision participation.

interpretation_boundary.d400_pass_means: The registered SDF configuration is authored and read back exactly, the stage is admitted, nonzero stage-wide cooking work drains without a registered log failure, the exact enabled SDF Mesh path is enumerated under the intended rigid-link query, and frozen robot properties remain invariant.
interpretation_boundary.d400_pass_does_not_mean: A per-prim internal SDF cook object was directly identified, the SDF collision shape participated in articulation contact, the cooked SDF surface is geometrically exact, contacts are correct, tipping is avoided, or the product can be grasped.
interpretation_boundary.next_authorization_boundary: First approve no-Isaac implementation/static attestation for exactly the two registered scripts, d400_reviewed_script_attestation.json, and d400_proposed_runtime_hash_tuple.json. Review all four file hashes and report the tuple-file SHA. Only an afterward runtime approval that explicitly cites that tuple-file SHA may authorize the one-worker Isaac/PhysX preflight.

forward_only_outputs_for_future_runtime.technical_fail_output_rule: Do not invoke Rerun after a worker technical failure; preserve all artifacts reached before failure. Their intentional absence is not an observability failure.
